note: BH-7643. The most conductor rebase rows (RB-<pr>-<head8>) the pool SPAWN walk starts in one tick. RB rows past it stay queued for the next tick, with one `rebase rows: <n> past pool_rb_max_per_tick=<max>` line, and the ticket rows behind them still get the budget. A row whose PR is closed or merged takes no slot: it is closed `empty: pr-closed` with no machine. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_rb_max_per_tick`. 0 = no limit. A value outside 0-1000 uses 4.
